words.gloss: towards one who has been trusted

literal: Trusting one who has not examined, and suspecting towards one who has been trusted, will give unending sorrow.
translation: Trusting someone without prior examination, and harboring suspicion toward someone who has already been trusted and chosen, will both yield unending misery.
modern: ஆராயாமல் ஒருவரை நம்புவதும், அவ்வாறு ஆராய்ந்து தெளிந்து தேர்ந்தெடுத்தவரிடம் சந்தேகம் கொள்வதும் நீங்காத துன்பத்தைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights two fatal errors in judgment and relationship management. First, trusting or employing someone without thoroughly examining their character and capabilities leads to disaster. Second, once a person has been carefully examined, trusted, and selected, constantly doubting or suspecting them destroys the relationship and ruins the work. Both of these actions are equally harmful and will result in endless, incurable misery.
